evals.name: multi-team-full-pipeline
evals.prompt: Run the pipeline on: 'How does spatial gene co-expression change during neural development?' Use multi-team mode with 3 teams, N=3, high-diversity personas, shared lit review, full tiered reanalysis, iterative deepening. This is a DRY RUN — output your complete execution plan listing every stage in order with: stage name, model, MCP tools used, validation checks, output files. Do NOT actually execute.
evals.expected_output: Complete execution plan listing all 17 multi-team stages including: lit review with MCP tools, hypothesis gen, branching, approach gen with dataset search, data acquisition with MCP downloads, MANDATORY analysis planner, iterative deepening loop (main-context-orchestrated), MANDATORY figure composition, paper gen with figure embedding, gene panel overlap, meta-comparison with claim extraction, reanalysis WITH code execution, final synthesis, and ALL 6 post-synthesis chain steps (supplementary tables, figure composition plan, reference validation, findings network, graphical abstract, audit manifest).

assertions.text: Plan includes literature review using MCP search tools (search_pubmed, search_semantic_scholar, search_openalex)
Plan includes Analysis Planner as mandatory/always-on stage (not optional)
Plan includes Figure Composition as a distinct stage between Analysis and Paper
Plan describes iterative deepening as main-context-orchestrated loop with separate Round and Reflection subagent dispatches
Plan includes Gene Panel Overlap as explicit stage after team pipelines
Plan includes Meta-Comparison as explicit stage with atomic claim extraction
Reanalysis description requires Python code execution (not just narrative reconciliation)
Plan includes ALL 6 post-synthesis chain steps: supplementary tables, figure composition plan, reference validation, findings network, graphical abstract, audit manifest
Plan mentions other_team_focuses or cross-team dataset complementarity
Plan mentions branching integrator or thread allocation after hypothesis generation

evals.name: single-team-simple
evals.prompt: Run a quick single-team pipeline on: 'Role of TP53 in treatment resistance across solid tumors'. Use N=1, standard mode. This is a DRY RUN — output your complete execution plan listing every stage in order with: stage name, model, MCP tools used, validation checks, output files. Do NOT actually execute.
evals.expected_output: Even in simple N=1 mode, plan should include ALL 9 single-team stages: lit review with MCP tools, hypothesis gen, approach gen, data acquisition, MANDATORY analysis planner, analysis with iterative deepening, MANDATORY figure composition, paper gen with figure embedding, post-processing with PDFs and supplementary tables.

assertions.text: Plan includes literature review using MCP search tools (not LLM recall)
Plan includes Analysis Planner as mandatory even for N=1
Plan includes Figure Composition as mandatory even for N=1
Plan includes iterative deepening with reflection loop even for N=1
Paper generation mentions embedding figures with ![caption](path) syntax
Post-processing includes supplementary tables (CSV)
Plan has 9 distinct stages (not fewer)

evals.name: resume-mid-pipeline
evals.prompt: The literature review and hypothesis generation are already done for a multi-team run on 'Spatial transcriptomics of tumor microenvironment heterogeneity'. The outputs are in experiment outputs/tme_spatial_2026-03-14/. Continue from approach generation through the end. This is a DRY RUN — output your complete execution plan for the REMAINING stages with: stage name, model, MCP tools, validation checks, output files. Do NOT actually execute.
evals.expected_output: Plan should list all remaining stages starting from approach generation, NOT skip any downstream stages just because we're resuming. Must include: approach gen, data acquisition, MANDATORY analysis planner, analysis with iterative deepening, MANDATORY figure composition, paper gen, all cross-team stages (gene panel overlap, meta-comparison, reanalysis with code execution, final synthesis, ALL 6 post-synthesis steps), post-processing.

assertions.text: Plan starts from approach generation (not re-running lit review or hypothesis)
Plan includes Analysis Planner as mandatory
Plan includes Figure Composition as mandatory
Plan includes iterative deepening with reflection loop
Plan includes all cross-team stages (gene panel overlap, meta-comparison, reanalysis, final synthesis)
Plan includes ALL 6 post-synthesis chain steps
Reanalysis requires code execution
